bound.walk: copy printed untemplated collection GET paths from the official Kartverket Høydedata OpenAPI paths object; native ids are the last printed path segment; access_path is the printed path joined to the spec's own relative servers[0].url /hoydedata/v1 on the OpenAPI origin; skip templated {datakilde} paths; do not invent endpoint ids
bound.how: pda ingest --source hoydedata --limit 10. The official Kartverket Høydedata OpenAPI prints 5 GET paths, of which 3 are untemplated collection paths. The adapter copies those 3 printed paths and joins each to /hoydedata/v1 on the OpenAPI origin. GET uses the printed path with no invented query filters.
